No assertion a specific China customer or FDI Vietnam company can independently buy local ERP. Internal intake records hypotheses and process/existing-system alternatives.
anchor_review.A3: FDI English commercial Fabless Operations/SCM; international English questions and accountable next steps, not VN supply-chain-entry promise. Fabless definition supplied in explanation caption; no WIP/OSAT acronym used without definition.
anchor_review.A4: Implicit business value is a shared basis for the next production decision and accountable update ownership. Cold pain->report conventions->stage/time/source->ownership->next decision. No ROI%, yield, cost saving, forecast outcome or promised automatic synchronization.
anchor_review.A5: N/A: FDI lane only, no domestic supplier-entry claim.
anchor_review.A6: Concrete lot/product reference, production periods/test classifications, stage/time/report source and update owner. Questions/process conventions, not unverified product functionality. Taiwan source states ERP/MES context separately. Illustrative chip/wafer carrier is not a fabricated chip layout or owned fab.
anchor_review.A7: Same Operations/SCM: shared report basis -> local Vietnam consulting/implementation discussion -> named China chip-design case. Prospect discussions of reporting/update responsibilities are separate from published customer implementation. Reader remains original China source summary; no fabricated Vietnam Fabless deployment or ERP-only causality.

Same Operations/SCM decision and reporting responsibility context. Taiwan ERP/MES management/production context, Vietnam service scope and China customer implementation separately attributed.
